field_changes.before: The Senate Conservation Committee substitute proposed oversight of qualifying microgrids, renewable portfolio requirements and annual reporting, alongside limits on public utility rate increases for microgrid infrastructure; the bill passed the Senate but died in House committee. field_changes.after: The Senate Conservation Committee substitute proposed oversight of qualifying microgrids, renewable portfolio requirements and annual reporting, alongside limits on public utility rate increases for microgrid infrastructure. A February14 Senate floor amendment proposed county/population-based exemptions from the renewable portfolio standard, but the official bill history lists that amendment under Not Adopted; those exemptions were not adopted through that amendment. The bill failed in House committee. The fiscal report discusses data-center energy needs using agency comments on similar legislation; this does not establish that a particular data center qualifies.
